notes.title: Balance Patch - V 0.7.8
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and welcome to a new balancing patchnote!

[b][h2]Objectifs[/h2][/b]

This balance patch follows the release of several new maps linked to Chapter 2, and a stabilisation of the meta after the various releases. It was therefore necessary for us to take stock of the state of the game and propose relevant changes to the various maps, particularly those linked to Chapter 2. 

___________________________________________________________________

[b][h3]New Mechanic: Exhaustion[/h3][/b]

Based on our analysis and the many feedbacks we received from the community during early access, we noticed that Support cards with draw effects were too prevalent compared to what we had initially planned. This led to a style of play that relied heavily on the use of multiple Support cards over short periods to draw large volumes of cards. In order to bring the draw down to an acceptable level without applying a direct and violent penalty on the individual potential of the draw effects, we chose to introduce a new game mechanic called Exhaustion. 

Exhaustion is an individual global counter, reset to zero at the end of your turn, and used to limit the power of certain cards and effects. Initially, only Support cards will interact with this mechanic. 

Some Support cards now have the keyword Exhaustion. This keyword indicates 2 things: 

Firstly, when you play this card, at the end of the resolution of its effects, your Exhaustion counter increases by 1. 

Secondly, the power of the card's effects will be reduced according to the Exhaustion value. 

For example: all 6 Genetic Cycling cards will be affected by this keyword. During a turn, you start your turn with 0 Depletion. You play your first Genetic Cycling and draw 2 cards. If you play a second Genetic Cycling during the same turn, you will draw one less card due to Exhaustion. 

[Cards affected by Depletion[/b]

[b][list]
[*] Genetic Cycling - Tech
[/list][/b]

Discard a Tech mutant or Gadget card: draw 2 cards.

[b][list]
[*] Genetic Cycling - Blades
[/list][/b]

Discard a Blades mutant: draw 2 cards.

[b][list]
[*] Genetic Cycling - Zoo
[/list][/b]

Discard a Zoo mutant: draw 2cards.

[b][list]
[*] Genetic Cycling - Necro
[/list][/b]

Discard a Necro mutant: draw 2 cards.

[b][list]
[*] Genetic Cycling - Space
[/list][/b]

Discard a Space mutant: draw 2 cards.

[b][list]
[*] Genetic Cycling - Mystic
[/list][/b]

Discard a Mystic mutant: draw 2 cards.

[b][list]
[*] Bio-Recycling
[/list][/b]

Sacrifice one of your uninvoked mutants: draw 2 cards.

[b][list]
[*] Astragalomancy
[/list][/b]

Remove 2 Bone cards from your Discard Pile: Draw 2 cards

[b][list]
[*] Battle Plan
[/list][/b]

If you have at least 2 mutants with an activated Tactic on your field, draw 2 cards.

[b][list]
[*] Stylish Unity
[/list][/b]

If you control at least 2 uninvoked monogen mutants, draw 2 cards.

[b][list]
[*] IEM Bomb
[/list][/b]

Discard 1 card. Inflict 1 damage then stasis 2 to all entities on your field and the opponent's field.

___________________________________________________________________

[b][h3]Downward balancing (Nerfs)[/h3][/b]

[b][list]
[*] Capacoburger
[/list][/b]

Although one of the aims of Chapter 2 was to shift the gameplay somewhat towards monogen mutants, some of the cards supporting monogen archetypes proved even more effective than expected in the hands of the community, to the point of becoming deleterious to the game. Capacoburger in particular has opened the door to combinations based on sacrifice attacks to make huge holes in the opponent's defence, bringing the ability for a mutant to inflict 4 extra points of damage during an attack, as well as collateral damage. We're therefore going to reduce the magnitude of the card's effects quite significantly. 

ATK Bonus: +2 → +1

Indigestion: No longer affects buildings. 

___________________________________________________________________

[b][h3]Buffs[/h3][/b]

[b][list]
[*] Son of the Storm
[/list][/b]

The power of this mutant is slightly lower than that of other comparable mutants, due to its limited ability to stay on the field long enough to activate its ability multiple times. We've therefore decided to increase its defensive capacity a little to make it easier for it to resist direct attacks. 

HP increase: 1/2/3/4/6 → 2/3/4/6/9 HP

[b][list]
[*] Master Oida
[/list][/b]

This mutant, which has existed since the early days of the game, is still struggling to really find its place as an offensive support mutant. We've therefore decided to increase the power of the attack boost provided by his Action ability, while at the same time reducing his already high defensive potential thanks to his Evasion ability. 

Bonus ATK: +2/3/4/5/7 -> +3/4/5/6/8

HP: 1/3/5/7/10 -> 1/2/4/6/9

[b][list]
[*] Scarlett
[/list][/b]

The heroic mutant obtainable only via temporal rifts has proved to be slightly below expectations, due to her stats being a little too low. We are therefore readjusting her attack and HP upwards. 

ATQ: 6 → 7

HP: 6 → 7

[b][list]
[*] Vital Orb
[/list][/b]

The two orbs with Reforge do not have the same purpose. One is used to force an equivalent trade in order to recover a Forged Orb, while the other is used to win a battle by surviving it. In order to make the Vital Orb more petinent in its primary role, we have chosen to increase the VP bonus it confers.  

Bonus HP conferred: +1 → +2

[b][list]
[*] Unloading Crane
[/list][/b]

The current operation of this building makes it inefficient in its role as a mass gadget generator when several Tech mutants are destroyed. To overcome this problem, we're limiting the frequency of activation, but increasing the quantity of Gadgets generated to make it more stable in its operation.  

[b][list]
[*] Recycling: 
[/list][/b]

Before: When one of your Tech Mutants is destroyed, add 1 Gadget to your hand. 

After: Once per turn, when one of your Tech Mutants is destroyed, add 2 Gadgets to your hand.   

___________________________________________________________________


That's all for this patch,

Enjoy the game,

Team Genesis

___

notes.title: Balance Patch Summer 2024
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and welcome to a new balance patch!

___________________________________________________________________
[h3][b]Balancing down (Nerfs)[/b][/h3] 📉 
___________________________________________________________________

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/eef604b43bffee34fc0fa51a3805745f3b49a5a5.png[/img]

[i][b]Battle Plan[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] Battle Plan allowed Blades-Tactics decks to draw too easily. Generally speaking, we want to limit the use of cards that allow you to draw too much. The Battle Plan function has been slightly modified to allow you to draw a maximum of two cards.
[/list]

Before: For each mutant with an activated Tactics ability on your field, draw one card (max. 3).

After: If you have at least 2 mutants with an activated Tactics ability on your field, draw 2 cards. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/9cd95ab602be181e94cc6fa81d413b25885b8262.png[/img]

[i][b]Planning Table[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] Mutants with Tactics benefit too easily from this Building, which gives them power and survivability. In order to limit the impact of this card, we are removing the survivability aspect from its bonus. 
[/list]

[i]Tactical Advantage Ability:[/i]

Before: Passive - All your mutants with Tactics activated have +1 ATQ and +1 HP. 

After: Passive - All your mutants with Tactics activated have +1 ATK. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/0bfa7f6ecbb025da3d3e02c0f40a027602669672.png[/img]

[i][b]Orbital Strike[/b][/i]

[list][*] The new Heroic Support card is very powerful.We'd like to keep it being play, but reduce its damage slightly.
[/list]

Before: Discard a card: deals 5 damage to the targeted enemy mutant. 
If the target is a Heroic or Boss mutant, draw a card. 

After: Discard a card: deals 4 damage to the targeted enemy mutant. If the target is a Heroic Mutant or Boss, draw a card. 

___________________________________________________________________
[h3][b]Upward Balancing (Buffs)[/b][/h3] 📈
___________________________________________________________________

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/c2bed863ddf4ac78309776c202e163e334c95f30.png[/img]

[i][b]Reconstruction[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] This card, which allows you to exchange one building for another, is proving too costly for most decks. We've decided to add an option with Space decks to use it more effectively.
[/list]

Before: Discard a Building: Add a Building from your deck to your hand. 

After: Discard a Building or Galactic Mutant: Add a Building from your deck to your hand. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/fa441ba0746b243b4709d8031aaa69d38fc88f59.png[/img]

[i][b]Engineering Lab[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] The impact of this building was too weak to allow its use in Autorepair decks. We are increasing its effects.
[/list]

[i]Technical Revision Capability:[/i]

Before: Passive - When one of your mutants is healed by Autorepair, it gets +1 ATQ. 

After: Passive - When one of your mutants is healed by Autorepair, it gains +1 ATQ and +1 HP. 

___________________________________________________________________
[h3][b]Functional modifications (Reworks)[/b][/h3] 📊
___________________________________________________________________

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/635e3845cb7b3af720f57b46827c3dbc7eba69ca.png[/img]

[i][b]Beast[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] Sometimes too powerful, sometimes too weak, Beast's current mode of operation was struggling to find its balance. So we decided to completely redesign the mutant's kit while retaining its random, offensive side.
[/list]

Midnight Fang Ability: Removed

New ability: Howl

At Basic rank

Rush - When this mutant comes into play, a random mutant on your field gains +1 ATK until the end of the turn. 

At subsequent ranks

Evolution - When this mutant evolves, a random mutant on your field gets +1/2/3/4 ATK until end of turn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/7a16a2fb8ab437508eb93e1ab89ac6dbb655e6fa.png[/img]

[i][b]Sorceress[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] This mutant, obtainable via temporal rifts, was lacking something to function effectively. In order to bring this one up to speed and make it playable in certain Mystic archetypes as well, we're adding an Active ability to it that will synergise with its Execution ability. 
[/list]

New ability: Explosive Sorcery

Action: Inflicts 1/1/2/2/3 damage to the targeted mutant. 

ATK : 2/3/4/6/7 → 2/3/4/5/6

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/2f02c7eea55a3ab538d4418c92857eb11a0bd15a.png[/img]

[i][b]Astragalomancy[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] In the same way as its Tactical Battle Plan counterpart, we've decided to change the way Astragalomancy works to make it easier to play, but limit the number of cards drawn by its effect. 
[/list]

Before: Remove 3 Bones from your Discard Pile to draw 3 cards.

After: Remove 2 Bones from your Discard Pile to draw 2 cards.

___________________________________________________________________

notes.title: The first Major Content Update is coming out!
notes.notes:
Greetings Psycogs,

We are super excited to share with you a great news! Our next major content update is right around the corner! Titled: [b]Ascension[/b], it will follow up on where we left off the story during Chapter 1 and introduce new elements of lore, new fights and obviously new cards!

But before going more in depth with its content, let’s check out our Game’s Director letter to the community: 

[quote=Doc]Dear Psycogs,

On behalf of the entire Mutants: Genesis team, we would like to thank you for your unfailing support since the start of early access, your constant feedback and your constant encouragement.

Being able to talk to you and see how much you like the game, particularly on our community discord, is a very important source of motivation and encouragement for us. This first year of Early Access has been a rich one in many ways: the arrival of Time Rifts, the mobile version (iOS coming soon), the many ranked seasons in which you've fought hard, the Simulacrum (even the Extreme mode couldn't resist the most valiant among you), and above all, even if it's something less visible to you, the major work on stability and bug-fixing on the game, have made this a very beneficial year for the game, which has been able to consolidate its foundations.

Today, to celebrate the start of this second year of Early Access, the team is very proud to finally be releasing the sequel to our campaign, which you seem to be looking forward to just as much as we are: Chapter 2: Ascension.

After passing the Atika trials and being named captain of the Panakeia Junior Team, it's time for you and your two companions to get back into the thick of things. In this new arc, you'll be travelling to the 4 corners of the world to take on the biggest corporations and their champions. Each sub-section corresponds to a corporation represented by one of the game's 6 genes, and the confrontations will lead you to meet some colourful characters, learn about their personal histories, and battle them for the title of Xtrem Junior League of the Year. In this new arc, you'll learn more about the world of Mutants: Genesis, not to mention your rewards: new cards with every victory! 

We hope you enjoy this story arc and that it lives up to your expectations.

As for the sequel, we've still got plenty of surprises in store for you. If you want to know which one I'm personally most looking forward to, I invite you to re-read our last article, in which you'll find a sneak preview of the next boss you might come across after this arc 2!

To conclude this letter, I'd also like to thank and welcome all the new Psycogs who join us every day. Mutants: Genesis is above all a community game that needs its players to thrive. If you're looking for other Psycogs to chat to, or if you're looking to take on the titans, I can only recommend that you join our Discord once again.

We hope to see you soon![/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/a6dbef61e36b125be249a33f751e2ad1245ae555.jpg[/img]

So here we are guys, a new chapter opens up on the world of [i][b]Mutants: Genesis[/b][/i]! 

Let’s now dive into how this content will be released and what you can expect!

A new part of Chapter 2 will be released every 2 weeks, introducing a corporation, its leader and of course new cards, rewards and packs to get new skins or cardback! 
With 6 Genes, that’s more than 12 weeks of content coming up! Of course, a Chapter would not be complete without its boss. A special encounter that will offer a new challenge to existing and new players as well as as introducing a new Time Rift challenge!

As the new leader of the Panakeia team, you will have to travel around the world to be the very best. This will introduce you to new cards, corporation and gene specific strategies and of course, a cool fight with the leader of another team!

All new cards will be thematized around a Corporation specific gene, and so will be mono-gene! You’ll be able to collect 2 new mutants and a building or support card per Gene. So 18 new cards in total!

In addition to all of this, you will be able to purchase one of our Sponsorship Pack including:

[list]
[*] 2 Skins
[*] An exclusive card back
[*] 10 Gene specific capsules to get the new cards
[*] 
[/list]

[i]A.S.A also told us that a Mega Sponsorship Bundle will be available with a special discount![/i]

As you can see, there is lot to unpack in the coming weeks, and we are very excited to tell you that the first part of this Chapter will be out on the 17th of July! 

We’ll get the ball rolling with the Zoo gene and its corporation: [b]Noah’s Ark[/b]!

Stay tuned for an article detailing this first release. We’ll see you soon Psycogs, get ready to the biggest content update to come yet!

notes.title: Balance Patch - V 0.6.14
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and welcome to a new balance patch!

[h2][b]Objectives[/b][/h2]

This patch, which takes place several months after the previous one, has enabled us to study the evolution of the meta over a longer period, in order to allow it a longer phase of self-regulation. As a result, we were able to see a high degree of stability in the Blades Orbs archetype at the top, with a few minor excesses on the Zoo side. We also saw a slump in the Space and Mystics decks. 

[h3][b]Balancing down (Nerfs)[/b][/h3] 📉 
___________________________________________________________________

[i][b]Forged Orb[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] The addition of Forged Orbs in previous drops allowed one Orbs archetype to work very, if not too effectively, particularly play for a One-Turn Kill. However, this was not the intended purpose of these orbs. So we decided to limit their power by removing their ATK bonus. 
[/list]

[b]Before:[/b] The equipped mutant has +1 ATK and +1 HP. 

[b]After:[/b] The equipped mutant has +1 HP. 


[i][b]El Gringo[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] This pistolero is far too fast in both his attacks and his growth, allowing him to fire one shot after another and take very large quantities of EVO without risk. We've therefore decided to limit his growth rate and adjust his stats accordingly. 
[/list]

[b]Evolve curve:[/b] 1/2/3/4 → 2/3/4/5

[b]EVO:[/b] 1/2/3/4/6 → 1/3/4/6/9

[b]ATK:[/b] 2/3/4/5/7 → 2/4/5/6/8

[b]PV:[/b] 2/3/4/5/7 → 2/4/5/6/8


[i][b]Skirmish Tower[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] The Orb Support Building has become too powerful with the emergence of Forged Orbs, as large numbers of them can be played via card effects. We're therefore adjusting the power of the Building to take account of this greater influx of Orbs. 
[/list]

[b]First Strike Capacity: [/b]

[b]Before:[/b] Passive - When you equip an Orb on a mutant, the Equipped mutant gets +2 ATK this turn.

[b]After:[/b] Passive - When you equip an Orb on a Mutant, the Equipped Mutant gets +1 ATK this turn.


[i][b]Mecharachnidian[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] The heroic spider is at it again. We've analysed how the card is used, and we've decided to limit its direct impact a little by reducing its base stats slightly to make it more vulnerable and less dangerous. 
[/list]

[b]ATQ:[/b] 6 → 5

[b]HP:[/b] 6 → 5

___________________________________________________________________

[h3][b]Upward Balancing (Buffs)[/b][/h3] 📈 

___________________________________________________________________


[i][b]Behemoth[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] The gigantic alien had a power with an alternating progression between an increase in attack bonus and HP bonus, making some of its ranks more effective defensively and others offensively. 
[/list]

[b]Heavy Security Ability:[/b]

[b]Before:[/b] Architecture - For each Building on your field, this mutant has +1/1/2/2/3 ATQ and +0/1/1/2/3 HP.

[b]After:[/b] Architecture - For each Building on your field, this mutant has +1/1/2/2/3 ATQ and +1/1/2/2/3 VP.


[i][b]Gargantua[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] This member of the trio formed with Tengu and Thor was less powerful than his fellows, being more specialised against buildings. As its damage potential is too limited, we're increasing the overall damage of its ability. 
[/list]

[b]Meteor Smash ability:[/b] 

[b]Damage:[/b] 1/2/3/4/5 → 2/3/4/5/7


[i][b]Lichlock[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] This mutant's drawing power was slightly underestimated, given that the mutant takes time to incubate. We are therefore increasing its draw ability at all ranks. 
[/list]

[b]Forbidden Knowledge ability: [/b]

[b]Before:[/b] Testament - When this mutant is destroyed, draw 1/2/3/4/5 cards.

[b]After:[/b] Testament - When this mutant is destroyed, draw 2/3/4/5/6 cards.

___________________________________________________________________

[h3][b]Functional modifications (Reworks)[/b][/h3] 📊

___________________________________________________________________

[b]Reforge Keyword[/b]

Both Power Orb and Health Orb cards feature the Reforge mechanic, which allowed the player to draw a card when the equipped mutant was destroyed. However, this mechanic allowed you to cycle through your deck far too quickly in combination with the other cards dedicated to supporting Orbs. We've therefore decided to bring forward a change to the Reforge ability on these two cards, which will allow them to produce a Forged Orb instead of drawing. 

This will ensure a degree of stability in the way the cards linked to Orbs work, by ensuring that the card obtained when the Reforge ability is triggered is necessarily an Orb, without giving these orbs an overpowered advantage over the others. 

[i][b]Reforge[/b][/i]

[b]Before:[/b] When the mutant to which this orb is equipped is destroyed, draw 1 card.

[b]After:[/b] When the mutant to which this orb is equipped is destroyed, add a Forged Orb to your hand.

___________________________________________________________________


That's all for this patch, and don't forget it'll be available on Wednesday, March 13th!

Enjoy the game,

Team Genesis

notes.title: Balance Patch Season 4
notes.notes:
Hello Psycogs!

Here's the balancing patch that will be released on Wednesday, November 22. Here are a few words from the Dev team to help you find out more, as well as the list of Buffs and Nerfs. 

Let's get started!


[h2][b]Objectives[/b][/h2]

In this patch, we've chosen to rebalance certain archetypes that had a few too many options for inflicting an OTK (One-Turn Kill, a combination of cards and actions to reduce the opponent's Psycore HP to 0 in a single turn) on the opponent and preparing for the release of new cards. In particular, the archetypes linked to Summoning had options that were a little too effective for the difficulty of setting them up. 

[h3][b]Balancing down (Nerfs)[/b][/h3] 📉 

___________________________________________________________________

[i][b]Mephisto[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] The demonic mutant has too much defensive capacity, as he uses summons to get better stats and his Evasion ability. We've decided to make it targetable again in standard situations. 
[/list]
[b]Evasion keyword:[/b] Removed

___________________________________________________________________

[i][b]Battle Plan[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] The support card for Mutants with Tactics has a power cap that is a little too high given that it has no cost. Rather than adding a cost to this card, we prefer to limit its excesses by adding a limit to the number of cards drawn.  
[/list]
[b]Draw effect:[/b] Limited to 3 cards. 

___________________________________________________________________

[i][b]Mass Cannon[/b][/i]
[i]Like the previous card, the Mass Cannon has too high a power cap, given that the card is mainly used as a tool to end a game. We are therefore limiting its power to a maximum of 6 damage[/i].

[b]Damage inflicted by its effect[/b]: Limited to 6 damage. 

___________________________________________________________________

[i][b]Bio Recycling[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] The Bio Recycling card is a little too easy to use by sacrificing summons, so we've decided to limit its use to non-summoned mutants. 
[/list]

[b]Before:[/b] Destroy one of your mutants: Draw 2 cards.

[b]After:[/b] Destroy one of your non-summoned mutants: Draw 2 cards.
___________________________________________________________________

[i][b]Pandavinci[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] The little painter panda proved to be a little too powerful in his defensive capacities in pvp. We have therefore decided to add a negative counterpart to his summoning. 
[/list]

[b]EVO given by Shinigami[/b] : 0 → 1

___________________________________________________________________

[i][b]Sun-Duke[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Mutant Squad Commander Heroic was a little too effective on his own compared to his incubation time. We're therefore reducing the bonus he gets depending on the other mutants with Squad in the field. 
[/list]

[b]Fleet Commander[/b] ability: 

[b]Before[/b]: This mutant has +2 ATK and +2 HP for each mutant with Squad on your field.  

[b]After[/b ]: This mutant has +1 ATK and +1 HP for each mutant with Squad on your field.  

___________________________________________________________________

[h3][b]Upward Balancing (Buffs)[/b][/h3] 📈 

___________________________________________________________________

[i][b]Cerberus[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] The Soul Devouring Hellhound was sorely lacking in base power, so we've decided to increase its attack value at all ranks. 
[/list]

[b]Stats change: [/b]

[b]Attack[/b] : 1/3/4/6/7 → 2/4/5/8/9

___________________________________________________________________

[b]Big Medpack[/b]
[list]
[*] This multi-target healing card had too little ability to heal compared to single-target alternatives such as the Intermediate Medkit.  We have decided to raise its heal value to make it more relevant in its role.
[/list]

[b]Heal[/b] : 4 → 6

___________________________________________________________________

[h3][b]Functional modifications (Reworks)[/b][/h3] 📊

___________________________________________________________________
 
[i][b]Dreadnought[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] The support ship of the Squad archetype was not able to function in the way we wanted in the current game environment. So we decided to reorient its operation as a major mutant of the Squad archetype, with the ability to fetch other mutants in your deck, while retaining the ability to attack
[/list]
[b]New stats[/b]

ATK: 7 → 7

HP: 8 → 7

[b]Abilities[/b]

Armor Ability 2: Retained

Squad Ability: Retained

Support Platform Ability: Removed

Broadcast Orders Ability: Removed

Dual Core Ability added

Quick Teleport Ability added:

Action, Discard a Tech or Space mutant, or a Gadget card: Search your Deck for a non-Heroic mutant with Squad and put it into play. 

___________________________________________________________________

[i][b]Strength in Numbers[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] The support card for the Summon archetype gave a little too much direct impact and had too much OTK potential early in the game. We've therefore decided to revise the way it works to limit its short-term power. From now on, the card only gives +1 ATK to all your mutants, but this bonus persists after the end of the turn for your Summoned mutants. 
[/list]

[b]Before:[/b] Each mutant you control gets +1 ATK until end of turn. Each Summoned mutant gets an additional +1 ATK.

[b]After:[/b] Each non-Summoned mutant you control gets +1 ATK until the end of the turn. Each Summoned mutant you control gets +1 permanent ATK instead. 

___________________________________________________________________

[i][b]Zeus[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] The god of lightning and king of Olympus was in his current form too powerful in the centre of certain OTK decks. We've therefore decided to completely overhaul his Divine Punishment ability and reorient it around an effect more related to his name, with the aim of punishing opposing actions, rather than encouraging the use of multiple cards with no possible opposing response. 
[/list]

[b]Divine Punishment[/b] Ability: 

Before: Whenever you or your opponent plays a card, this mutant deals 1 damage to each opposing Building and Psycore. 

After: Each time your opponent plays a card, this mutant inflicts 2 damage to each opposing Building and Psycore. 

___________________________________________________________________


That's all for this patch, and don't forget it'll be available on Wednesday, November 22!

Enjoy the game,

Team Genesis.

notes.title: Season 3 Balance Patch
notes.notes:
Hello Psycogs!

Here is the next balancing patch that will be live on Wednesday, October 4. As usual, here are a few words from the Dev team to find out more, as well as the list of Buffs and Nerfs. 

Let's dive right in!

[b][h2]Objectives[/h2][/b]

2023’s season 2 was far more balanced, at least in terms of deck diversity. However, Zoo decks (and at a lesser scale, Tech decks) still have a dominating presence in the PvP scene over the others, and Mystic decks are the least favored child.

[b][h3]Downward balancing (Nerfs)[/h3][/b]

___________________________________________________________________

[b]Beast[/b]
[list]
[*] The Zoo Psycore based on the Beast starter keeps on being the most played Starter since season 1. Its ability do deal damage on the opposing battlefield (even if a bit unreliably) makes it often a first choice starter, overshadowing most basic Zoo mutants. We chose to weaken it by making it far more random and risky, in the line of Zoo’s randomness. 
[/list]

[b]Midnight Fangs Ability[/b]
[i]BEFORE[/i]
When this mutant enters play/evolves, it deals [1-1-1-2-3] damage to a random opposing entity. 

[i]AFTER[/i]
When this mutant enters play/evolves, it deals [1-1-1-2-3] damage to another random entity on your or your opponent’s battlefield.

___________________________________________________________________

[b]Scrap-Metal Cannon[/b]
[list]
[*] The Scrap-Metal Cannon is too efficient in its ability to target and destroy the opposing Psycore, bypassing Guardian Buildings and Mutants. To limit that card’s power in PvP and Siege battles, we make it able to target only Mutants. 
[/list]

[i]BEFORE[/i]
Discard any number of Tech mutants or Parts cards. Deal 2 piercing damage to target entity for each discarded card. 

[i]AFTER[/i]
Discard any number of Tech mutants or Parts cards. Deal 2 piercing damage to target mutant for each discarded card. 

Note : The Scrap-Metal cannon still works on the Battle Simulacrum, as it’s a Mutant. 

___________________________________________________________________

[b]Laser Printer[/b]
[list]
[*] The Laser Printer is a very effective Building to fill your board with Starter mutants. We limit its long-term generation so that the Old Printer remains a viable alternative.
[/list]

New stats : HP reduced from [3] to [2]

___________________________________________________________________

[b][h3]Upward balancing (Buffs)[/h3][/b]

___________________________________________________________________

[b]Cerberus[/b]
[list]
[*] Cerberus was lightly understatted, we upped its ATK in consequence. 
[/list]

New stats : ATK increased from [1-3-4-6-7] to [2-4-5-7-8]

___________________________________________________________________

[b]Dilophoraptor[/b]
[list]
[*] We determined temporary ATK penalties were not as powerful as we expected them to be, so we make them permanent. 
[/list]

[b]Blinding Toxin ability[/b]
[i]BEFORE[/i]
When this mutant enters play/evolves, inflict -[1-2-2-3-100] ATK on a random oppposing mutant until the end of turn.

[i]AFTER[/i]
When this mutant enters play/evolves, inflict -[1-2-2-3-100] ATK on a random oppposing mutant.

___________________________________________________________________

[b]Wicked Witch[/b]
[list]
[*] As per Dilophoraptor, we make its ATK penalty permanent, without changing its stats, while adjusting the ability power at Platinum rank, as this one was already permanent. 
[/list]

[b]Murder of Crows ability:[/b]
[i]BEFORE[/i]
Action - The target enemy mutant and all mutants on the same battlefield are inflicted with -[1-1-2-2] ATK until the end of turn.
Platine : Action - The target enemy mutant and all mutants on the same battlefield are inflicted with -[2] ATK.

[i]AFTER[/i]
Action - The target enemy mutant and all mutants on the same battlefield are inflicted with  -[1-1-2-2-3] ATK.

___________________________________________________________________

[b]Wrath[/b]
[list]
[*] Wrath was lightly understatted, and had a low survivability in most cases. We increase its HP at all ranks.
[/list]

New stats : HP increased from [2-3-5-7-9] to [3-4-6-8-10]

___________________________________________________________________

[b]Stealth Bot[/b]
[list]
[*] This mutant had a very situational ability. We decided to add it a small Stasis effect at Basic and Bronze ranks to both align it with other ranks and make its evolution more understandable.
[*] 
[/list]
The Backstab and Electric Backstab abilities are merged into one. 
[i]BEFORE[/i]

Action - Deal [1-2-2-3-4] and Stasis [0-0-2-2-2] to target mutant. Stealth-Bot loses Evasion until the beginning of your next turn. 

[i]AFTER[/i]

Action - Deal [1-2-2-3-4] and Stasis [1-1-2-2-2] to target mutant. Stealth-Bot loses Evasion until the beginning of your next turn. 

___________________________________________________________________

[b]Set Ablaze[/b]
[list]
[*] Even though that card’s power level on the long term was quite correct (6 damage over 3 turns), the card suffered greatly in comparison with all other forms of single-target direct damage or destruction. We increased its offensive ability to give it the ability to exert long-term pressure on powerful mutants.
[*] 
[/list]

[i]BEFORE[/i]

Discard a Mystic Mutant: Inflict Burning 3 to target mutant.

[i]AFTER[/i]

Discard a Mystic Mutant: Inflict Burning 4 to target mutant.

___________________________________________________________________

[b]The Forgotten One[/b]
[list]
[*] This Heroic Necro mutant has been part of the forgotten ones (pun intended) during this ranked season. We decided to improve it by simplifying her Eternal Despair ability, which now applies both stat increases when a mutant is destroyed, and we gave her a brand new effect. We adjusted its stats accordingly.
[/list]

New Stats: HP reduced from [9] to [8]

[b]Eternal Despair ability[/b]

[i]BEFORE[/i]
Whenever a mutant you control is destroyed, this mutant has +1 ATK. Whenever an opposing mutant is destroyed, this mutant has +1 HP.

[i]AFTER[/i]

Whenever another mutant is destroyed on your or your opponent’s battlefield, this mutant has +1 ATK, +1 PV and your Psycore is healed by 1.

___________________________________________________________________


[h3][b]Mechanical changes (Reworks)[/b][/h3]

___________________________________________________________________


[b]Monocerus[/b]
[list]
[*] Monocerus has been part of the most played mutants since the first ranked season, despite a first modification of its ability. Given the huge number of Zoo/Tech Basic mutants, we decided to change Monocerus to an advanced mutant, in order to balance the distribution of such mutants. Its stats have been rebalanced according to the new design. 
[/list]

Mutant Subtype: Basic → Advanced

[b]New Stats:[/b]

Evolution Curve: EVO necessary to evolve : Increased from [1-2-3-4] to [2-3-4-5]

EVO given on destruction : Increased from [1-2-3-4-6] to [2-3-4-6-9]

ATK: Reduced from [2-3-5-8-10] to [2-3-4-6-8]

HP: Increased [2-3-6-9-11] to [3-5-7-10-12]


That's it for this patch, don't forget that it will be available wednesday 4th of october!

Have a great game,

Team Genesis.

notes.title: Mutants: Genesis - Balance Patch Season 2
notes.notes:
Dear Psycogs,

Welcome to this second balance patch. You'll find Nerfs and Buffs and reworks of certain cards.

[b]This patch is already deployed![/b]


[h2][b]Objectives[/b][/h2]

Season 2 was far better balanced in terms of deck composition. However, we continue to see Zoo decks having a domineering position over the others. 

This balance patch main objective is to lessen Zoo impact so that the current meta changes, and give a push to two deck archetypes currently absent in the competitive scene : Boneyard and Tactics.


[h3][b]NERFS[/b][/h3]


[list]
[*] [i][b]Cernunnos[/b][/i]
[/list]

Cernunnos currently has too high statistics. Instead of reducing these statistics, we increase the EVO required to evolve. 

[b]Evolution curve[/b] : 

EVO necessary to evolve increases from [1-2-3-4] to [3-4-5-7].

[list]
[*] [i][b]Solar Lampyrion[/b][/i]
[/list]

The previous rework of Solar Lampyrion made it a lot stronger, but too versatile. We rebalance its overall potential by reducing its offensive power, without changing its support ability. 

[b]New statistics:[/b] ATK reduced from [8] to [6]

[b]Solar Eruption ability:[/b] Area damage reduced from [3] to [2]

[list]
[*] [i][b]Rakshasa[/b][/i]
[/list]

This mutant introduced in the Pioneer Drop is currently too powerful with the Forged Orb generation. To reduce its raw power, we slightly reduce its HP value and introduce a limitation to its Unsheathe ability.

[b]New statistics: [/b]

HP reduced from [3-5-7-8-9] to [2-4-6-7-8]

[b]Tiger Rage ability: [/b]

[i]Before[/i]

Unsheathe - Whenever this mutant is equipped with an Orb, it deals damage equal to its ATK to a random opposing mutant. 

[i]After[/i]

Unsheathe - Once per turn, when this mutant is equipped with an Orb, it deals damage equal to its ATK to a random opposing mutant. 

[list]
[*] [i][b]Genshiryoku[/b][/i]
[/list]

This mutant had a too massive impact as soon as it arrived in play, especially in Zoo archetypes able to trigger Kaiju domination during a single turn through support cards. 

[b]New statistics: [/b]

HP reduced from [3-5-7-10-13] to [2-4-6-9-12] 

ATK reduced from [3-5-7-9-11] à [2-4-6-8-10]

[b]Kaiju Domination ability: [/b]

ATK bonus reduced from [1-2-2-3-3] to [1-1-2-2-3]. 

HP bonus reduced from [1-1-2-3-3] to [1-1-2-2-3]

[list]
[*] [i][b]Leviathan[/b][/i]
[/list]

Contrary to our previous announcement in July, the damage of Leviathan’s Tsunami at Bronze rank have not changed. We realign them according to the announcement.

[b]Tsunami ability: [/b]

Area Damage to Buildings reduced from [1-2-2-2-3] to [1-1-2-2-3]

[list]
[*] [i][b]Defensive Shield[/b][/i]
[/list]

This is the most-played buiding in the game. We have decided to increase the EVO given when it is destroyed to mitigate its current impact in game, especially in PvP, while keeping its defensive PvE potential against Bosses. 

[b]EVO given on destruction:[/b] Increased from [2] to [3]

[list]
[*] [i][b]The Anvil[/b][/i]
[/list]

The Anvil was able to produce too many Forged Orbs over a too long duration. We limited the generation potential to 3 Orbs over 3 turns. 

[b]Auto-Smithing ability: [/b]

Self-Damage increased from [1] to [2]

[b]New statistics: [/b]

PV increased from [5] to [6]


[h3][b]BUFFS[/b][/h3]


[list]
[*] [i][b]Azog[/b][/i]
[/list]

This mutant had a passive ability with an extremely situational impact. We decided to add it a new Tactics ability, allowing it better possibilities to interact with Mystic decks, while adjusting its statistics towards its defense. 

[b]New statistics: [/b]

ATK reduced from [3-5-7-11-14] to [2-4-5-7-10]

HP increased from [3-5-6-7-10] to [3-5-6-8-12]

[b]New ability:[/b]

Chamanic Strength - Tactics - While you control a Mutant with an Active ability, this mutant has +[2-3-4-5-7] ATK. 

[list]
[*] [i][b]Marship Mallow[/b][/i]
[/list]

This mutant was weaker than planned at the Basic rank, so we slightly improve its attack. 

[b]New statistics: [/b]

ATQ increased from [1-2-4-6-7] to [2-2-4-6-7]

[list]
[*] [i][b]Ghostmonaut[/b][/i]
[/list]

The ability of this mutant used to trigger when one of your buildings was destroyed. Even though it had Evasion, it was usually far more interesting to destroy it before attacking buildings. Its new version deals a little less damage, but now applies when a building on either your or your opponent’s battlefield is destroyed, allowing it to be played in Space archetypes revolving around Cityscape, Deployment and Demolition.

[b]Space Debris ability: [/b]

[i]Before[/i]

Passive - Whenever one of your buildings is destroyed, this mutant deals [2-2-3-4-6] damage to the opposing mutant with the lowest HP. 

[i]After[/i]

Passive - Whenever a Building on either your or your opponent's battlefield is destroyed, this mutant deals [1-1-2-3-5] damage to the opposing mutant with the lowest HP. 

[list]
[*] [i][b]Bushi[/b][/i]
[/list]

As all mutants with Boneyard abilities, its ability didn’t reward enough the risks taken to activate it. We readjusted its statistics and focused its ability towards a better offensive power. 

[b]New statistics: [/b]

ATK increased from [2-2-4-6-9] to [2-3-5-7-9] 

HP reduced from [2-4-6-8-10] to [2-3-5-7-9]

[b]Veterancy ability: [/b]

[i]Before[/i]

Boneyard - While you have at least 10 cards in your Discard, this mutant has +[2-2-3-4-6] ATK and +[2-2-3-4-6] HP.

[i]After[/i]

Boneyard - While you have at least 10 cards in your Discard, this mutant has +[2-3-4-5-7] ATK.

[list]
[*] [i][b]Dead Bot[/b][/i]
[/list]

As all mutants with Boneyard abilities, its ability didn’t reward enough the risks taken to activate it. We decided to increase the Armor bonus given by its ability, granting it a huge potential to attack other mutants. 

[b]Reactive Shielding ability: [/b]

Armor bonus increased from [1-1-2-2-4] à [2-2-3-4-5]

[list]
[*] [i][b]Mirror Reflector[/b][/i]
[/list]

This building was not very popular, due to its complex triggering conditions and a random targeting. We changed its targeting to focus weaker mutants to give it more offensive capabilities. 

[b]Energy Inverter ability:[/b]

[i]Before[/i]

Whenever one of your mutants is healed, deal 1 damage to a random opposing mutant. 

[i]After[/i]

Whenever one of your mutants is healed, deal 1 damage to the opposing mutant with the lowest HP.

[list]
[*] [i][b]Drill Orb[/b][/i]
[/list]

Due to the appearance of the Forged Orb, we improved it to give it an edge over the generated Orb card. 

[b]New statistics: [/b]

HP bonus while equipped to a mutant increased from [0] to [1]


[h3][b]REWORKS[/b][/h3]


[list]
[*] [i][b]Warrior[/b][/i]
[/list]

This starter mutant had a Tactics ability with a harsh activation condition, making it too complex to play efficiently. We changed its ability to have its attack bonus while a mutant is on the opposing battlefield. 

[b]Sanguinary ability: [/b]

[i]Before[/i]

Tactics - While an opposing mutant is damaged, this mutant has +[1-1-2-3-4] ATK.

[i]After[/i]

Tactics - While your opponent controls a mutant, this mutant has +[1-1-2-3-4] ATQ.

[list]
[*] [i][b]Charon[/b][/i]
[/list]

The guardian of the Styx was too slow and unefficient in its previous role. Now as a guardian of Hell, it has a Boneyard ability giving it a massive attack bonus while active. 

[b]Stygian Flows ability:[/b]

[i]Before[/i]

Passive - Whenever a card enters your opponent’s Discard, this mutant has +[1] ATK.

[i]After[/i]

Boneyard - While you have at least 10 cards in your discard, this mutant has +[6] ATK. 

[list]
[*] [i][b]Commander Ender[/b][/i]
[/list]

As all mutants with Boneyard abilities, its ability didn’t reward enough the risks taken to activate it. We reworked this mutant to improve its terrifying side. The mutant is now an Advanced mutant, has its statistics readjusted accordingly, and now also applies an attack penalty to opposing mutants in addition to its autorepair bonus. It now no longer has additional HP depending on allied discards content. 

[b]Mutant Subtype:[/b] Basic → Advanced

[b]Evolution curves: [/b]

EVO necessary to evolve: [2-3-4-5]

EVO given on destruction increases from [1-3-4-6-9] to [2-3-4-6-9]

[b]New statistics: [/b]

ATQ changes to [2-4-6-8-10] 

PV changes to [3-5-6-8-11]

[b]Unstoppable ability: [/b]

[i]Before [/i]

For each allied discard pile that contains at least 10 cards, this mutant has Autorepair [1-1-1-2-3] and  +[0-0-1-2-3] PV.

[i]After[/i]

For each allied discard pile that contains at least 10 cards, this mutant has Autorepair [1-1-2-2-3] and opposing mutants have -[1-1-1-2-3] ATK. 

That's it for this patch,

Hope you'll enjoy it! Have a great day!

Team Mutants Genesis

Dear Psycogs, 

Welcome to this first Card Balance Patch! Season 1 2023 was dominated by Zoo decks including  [i][b]Beast[/b][/i] as well as Tech Decks.
The objective of this balancing was to reverse the meta and push new deck archetypes forward while lowering the impact of the most present decks.

You'll be introduced to Nerfs and Buffs. Respectively modifications to make a card less or more powerful.

[b]This patch will be online Wednesday 19 2023![/b]

Let's go together through the details:

[h3][b]CARDS NERFS[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*][i][b]Beast[/b][/i]
[/list]
[i][b]Beast[/b][/i] is one of the most powerful and played starter mutant.  We are lowering the damages of its evolving ability in higher ranks to lower its impact in ultra agressive Zoo decks.

[b]Ability Midnight Fang : Damages reduced from [1-1-2-3-4] to [1-1-1-2-3][/b]

[list]
[*] [i][b]Monocerus[/b][/i]
[/list]
[i][b]Monocerus[/b][/i] was initially planned to be played in multiplayer modes. Still, its ability to generate a lot of Parts, even if its just Repair Nanites, make it too powerfull as a Part generator in PvP. We'll be lowering its ability to generate parts in higher ranks and adjust its stats accordingly.

[b]Ability Nanites Production : Number of parts reduced from [1-1-2-3-4] to [1-1-1-1-2][/b]

[b]New Stats:
ATK - [2-3-5-7-10] → [2-3-5-8-10]
HP - [2-3-5-7-10] → [2-3-6-9-11][/b]

[list]
[*] [i][b]Cyber-Croc[/b][/i]
[/list]
Just as [i][b]Monocerus[/b][/i], [i][b]Cyber-Croc[/b][/i]'s ability to generate parts without any cost make it a staple of Tech-Gadget decks. We'll be lowering its ability to generate Parts and raise the number of EVO needed to its evolution. Stats are adjusted accordingly.

[i]Note :[/i] Its stats and the number of EVO given will be adjusted with its new evolution curb.

[b]Ability Mechanisation : Number of parts reduced from [1-1-2-3-4] to [1-1-1-2-3][/b]

[b]Evolution curb : EVO needed to evolve [1-2-3-4] to [2-3-4-5]
[/b]

[b]New Stats:
ATK - [2-3-5-7-10] → [2-3-6-8-11][/b]

[list]
[*] [i][b]Leviathan[/b][/i]
[/list]
Star of OTK Zoo deck before our hotfix of [i][b]Natural Selection[/b][/i] and [i][b]Savage Strike[/b][/i], [i][b]Leviathan[/b][/i] remains a very powerful mutant able to combo with itself. We'll be lowering the damages of its ability to make it harder to evolve it in quick successions in order to destroy all the buildings and damage heavily the psycore.

[b]Ability Tsunami : Damages reduced from [1-2-2-3-4] to [1-1-2-2-3]
[/b]

[list]
[*] [i][b]Cernunnos[/b][/i]
[/list]
Cernunnos' stats were a bit too high. We'll be lowering its attack to put it back in a correct progression curve.

[b]New Stats: ATK lowered from [2-4-6-8-10] to [2-3-5-7-9]

[h3][b]CARDS BUFFS[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] [i][b]Thor[/b][/i]
[/list]
[i][b]Thor[/b][/i]'s abilities have been reinforced to better work with themslves and make the mutant stronger while rewarding players who discard cards from both genes.

[b]Ability Thunder Shock[/b]

[i]Before[/i]
If you've discarded a Blade mutant, inflicts damages to all other mutants on the target's field.
[i]After[/i]
If you've discarded a Blade mutant, inflicts [1-1-2-2-3] to the target and all other mutants on the field.

[b]Ability Lightning Bolt[/b]

[i]Before[/i]
If you've discarded a Mystic mutant, inflicts Stasis to the target Mutant.
[i]After[/i]
If you've discarded a Mystic mutant, inflicts Stasis [1-1-2-2-3] to all affected Mutants.

[b]Stats adjustment: 
HP : [3-5-6-9-12] → [3-5-7-9-12][/b]

[list]
[*] [i][b]Cursed Mausoleum[/b][/i]
[/list]
The ability Cursed Mausoleum has been modified to have an immediate impact when it arrives on the field.

[i]Before[/i]
At the end of your turn, create a Bones card in your discard.

[i]After[/i]
When it enters play and at the start of the turn, create a Bones card in your discard.

[list]
[*] [i][b]Catacomb Excavation[/b][/i]
[/list]
The number of Bones created has been upped.

[i]Before[/i]
Create 2 Bones in your discard.

[i]After[/i]
Create 3 Bones in your discard.

[list]
[*] [i][b]Howlosaurus[/b][/i]
[/list]
The second Zoo starter suffers from its opposition to [i][b]Beast[/b][/i]. Stats have been balanced to make it more polyvalent.

[b]New Stats:
ATK: [1-1-2-2-3] to [1-2-3-4-6]
HP: [1-3-4-6-9] to [1-2-3-4-6][/b]

[list]
[*] [i][b]The Forgotten[/b][/i]
[/list]
The basic heroic of the Necro gene suffers from a lack of impact when it arrives in game. Giving it the 
[i]Guardian[/i] ability forces the opponent to sacrifice mutants against it, fuelling its ability.

[b]New Keyword: Guardian[/b]

[list]
[*] [i][b]Zeus[/b][/i]
[/list]
The basic heroic of the Space gene gets a new defensive aspect to capitalize on its ability.

[b]New Stats: 
HP: 8 => 7[/b]

[b]Ability added: 
Olympos : Architecture - While you have a building, Zeus has Armor 2[/b]

[list]
[*] [i][b]Lady Cliodhna[/b][/i]
[/list]
The banshee queen gets a new defensive keyword. Her HP stats have been adapted in consequence.

[b]New Stats: 
HP : 7 => 6

New Keyword: Evasion.
[/b]

[list]
[*] [i][b]Darwin[/b][/i]
[/list]
The negative effect of its Rush ability was not rewarding players that were able to summon [i][b]Darwin[/b][/i]. His ability has been modified to entirely remove the negative effect. His stats have been slightly adjusted to account for this change.

[b]Ability Evolution Theory[/b]

[i]Before[/i]
When Darwin enters play, each other Mutants on the field gains 3 EVO and Darwin looses 1ATK and 1HP for each affected mutant.

[i]After[/i]
When Darwin enters play, each other Mutants on the field gains 3 EVO.

[b]Modified Stats:
ATK : 13 => 12
HP : 13 => 12[/b]

[list]
[*] [i][b]Shade of Kukulkàn[/b][/i]
[/list]
Shade of Kukulkàn has a very powerful effect when he arrives in play but his threat level diminishes afterward. A new ability has been added.

[b]New Ability:
Persisting Flames: Passive - At the start of the turn, inflicts Burn 2 to all opposing mutants.[/b]

[list]
[*] [i][b]Dreadnought[/b][/i]
[/list]
The defensive ability of [i][b]Dreadnought[/b][/i] has been reinforced. Its stats have been adapted in consequence.

[b]Modified Stats:
HP : 10 => 8

New Keyword: Armor 2[/b]

[list]
[*] [i][b]Tengu[/b][/i]
[/list]
Like [i][b]Thor[/b][/i], [i][b]Tengu[/b][/i]'s ability has been modified to offer better combos with its 2 other effects.

[quote]NOTE : Tengu will be updated in the next patch as we've encountered some technical issues that prevented it from being released today (19/07).[/quote]

[b]Ability Amnesia[/b]

[i]Before[/i]
If you've discarded a Zoo mutant, this mutant gains X EVO, X ATK and X HP.

[i]After[/i]
If you've discarded a Zoo mutant, this mutant gains X EVO, X ATK and X HP for every target hit.

[list]
[*] [i][b]Soul Pit[/b][/i]
[/list]
The power of [i][b]Soul Pit[/b][/i] has been upped to put it in the same level as cards like [i][b]Missile Turret[/b][/i] or [i][b]Imperishable Blaze[/b][/i]. 

[i]Before[/i]
When a mutant with Last Will you control is destroyed, inflicts 1 damage to the opposing Psycore.

[i]After[/i]
When a mutant with Last Will you control is destroyed, inflicts 2 damages to the opposing Psycore.

[list]
[*] [i][b]Incubator Pod[/b][/i]
[/list]
The resistance of the [i][b]Incubator Pod[/b][/i] has been upped to make it more difficult to destroy mutants incubating in it.

[b]New Stats:
HP: 4 => 5[/b]


[h3][b]CARDS REWORK[/b][/h3]


[b]Ability Ignite[/b]

The Ignite ability was a bit too weak defensively speaking. We are modifying the way it works so it triggers when your Mutants are attacked as well:

Ability modification:

[i]Before[/i]:
Ignite X - Everytime this Mutant attacks another Mutant, it also inflicts Burn X.

[i]After[/i]:
Ignite X - Everytime this Mutant inflicts battle damage, it also inflicts Burn X.

[b]Concerned Cards:[/b]

[list]
[*] [i][b]Demon[/b][/i]
[*] [i][b]Pit Lord[/b][/i]
[*] [i][b]Gorthaur the cruel[/b][/i]
[*] [i][b]Kung Chow[/b][/i]
[*] [i][b]Steam Warlord[/b][/i]
[/list]

[list]
[*] [i][b]Pit Lord[/b][/i]
[/list]

Following changes made to Ignite, the passive ability of Pit Lord became obsolete. He now has a new Aura ability.

[b]Ability Incandescent [/b] - Removed
[b]Ability Inferno[/b] - Modified

[i]Before[/i]
Aura - Double Burn effects on ennemy Mutants (Only at Platinum rank)

[i]After[/i]
Aura - All your Mutants have Ignite [1-1-1-2-3]

[list]
[*] [i][b]Mecharachnidian[/b][/i]
[/list]
[i][b]Mecharachnidian[/b][/i] wasn't working properly. It became a highly played card because its stats where too high because of how its ability worked. 
The card has been reworked to fit its initial design : one of a menace that transforms with time.

[b]New Stats:
ATK: 6, HP: 6, Armor 3[/b]

Ability Shapeshifting: Changes

[i]Before[/i]: 
Passive - At the start of your turn, this mutant has +6 ATQ until the end of the turn. At the start of your opponent's turn, this mutant has Armor 3 until the end of the turn.

[i]After[/i]:
Passive - When this mutant takes damage, it loses all its Armor stacks. While this mutant has no Armor, it has +3 ATK and Autorepair 3.

[list]
[*] [i][b]Gargantua[/b][/i]
[/list]
[i][b]Gargantua[/b][/i]'s abilities have been entirely changed to make it more polyvalent.

[b]Ability Meteor Strike
Base Damages:[1-2-3-4-5][/b]

[b]Ability Direct Impact[/b]

[i]Before[/i]:
If you've discarded a Space mutant, inflicts additionnal damages to the target.

[i]After[/i]:
If you've discarded a Space mutant, deals damage to all ennemy buildings in addition to the target.

[b]Ability Sismic Wave[/b]

[i]Before[/i] :
If you have discarded a Tech mutant, deals damages to all buildings on the target field.

[i]After[/i] :
If you've discarded a Tech mutant, generates [1-1-2-2-3] Parts depending on the number of targets hit.

New Stats:

[b]ATK : [3-5-7-9-12] → [2-4-6-8-10][/b]

[list]
[*] [i][b]Goliath[/b][/i]
[/list]
[i][b]Goliath [/b][/i]'s ability could be frustrating because a lot of Parts cards couldn't see their effects doubled. He got reinforced to become more defensive and decisive. 

[b]New Keyword: Guardian[/b]

[b]Ability Advanced Robotic[/b]

[i]Before[/i]:
Double the effects of the Parts played on him
[i]After[/i]:
Goliath earns +1HP Max et +1 Autorepair each time a Part is played on him.

[list]
[*] [i][b]Neo-Urban XIII[/b][/i]
[/list]
[i][b]Neo-Urban XIII[/b][/i] was suffering from 2 problems: he didn't have enough impact in Necro decks and wasn't impactful enough when he arrived after 4 turns of incubation. His base ability is reinforced and a new ability replace the previous one.

[b]Ability Violent Extraction[/b]

[i]Before[/i]:
Execution: When this mutant destroys another mutant, create 2 Parts in your hand.

[i]After [/i]:
Exécution: When this mutant destroys another mutant, create 3 Parts in your hand.

[b]Ability Artificial Life[/b]

[i]Before[/i]:
Passive - When a Part is played on this mutant, it gains ATK, HP and Autorepair.

[i]After[/i]:
Last Will: When Neo-Urban XIII is destroyed, if it's not your turn, it deals its ATK to the main opposing entity.

[list]
[*] [i][b]Void Turret[/b][/i]
[/list]
The offensive potential of [i][b]Void Turret[/b][/i] was too weak compared to other options. Its ability has been modified.

[i]Before[/i]:
Collapse: When this building is destroyed, inflicts 3 to the mutant that attacked it.

[i]After[/i]:
Collapse: When this building is destroyed, inflicts 3 piercing damage to a random opposing mutant.

[list]
[*] [i][b]Valkyrie[/b][/i]
[/list]
[i][b]Valkyrie[/b][/i] had trouble to find its place in any archetype. A new Tactics ability has been added to help it find a place in an archetype. A new Last Will has been added to ease it's integration in Blade decks while keeping its invocation theme.

[b]New Ability: 
Valhalla's Bond : Tactics - If you have a Warrior on the field, all your blade mutants have +[1-1-2-2-3] ATK [/b]

[b]New Stats:
HP: [1-2-2-3-5] à [0-1-1-2-3][/b]

[list]
[*] [i][b]Solar Lampyrion[/b][/i]
[/list]
[i][b]Solar Lampyrion[/b][/i] was too hard to deal with and plan with. Its ability has been simplified to make it more easy to use.

[b]Ability Solar Eruption[/b]

[i]Before[/i]:
Passive - When this mutant attacks, share all damages inflicted among all opposing entities.

[i]After[/i]:
Passive - When this mutant attacks, deal 3 damages to all opposing entities.

[b]New Stats: 
ATK : 8 → 8
HP : 10 → 10[/b]

[list]
[*] [i][b]Second Chance[/b][/i]
[/list]
Rework of the card to work with the Bones archetype.

[i]Before[/i]:

Discard a Necro mutant: Invoke a Zombie.

[i]After[/i]:
Discard a Necro mutant: Invoke a Silver Rank Ossembly.


Here you go for this patch!

Again, it will be out [b]Wednesday 19th July[/b] and we can't wait to see which decks you'll build!

Have a great day!

Team Genesis

The big day has arrived! Mutants: Genesis is now available on Steam. You will find below our first patchnote, related to this early access release.

[h1]Early Access Patchnote - May 10th, 2023.[/h1]

[h3][u]Mechanics changes[/u][/h3]
A number of new keywords have been introduced in the game, either to clarify how some abilities work, or because enough cards share a common game mechanic to make it a keyword. 

[i]Unstable[/i]
A mutant with Unstable is stronger than average. However, it has an ability with a negative effect (like damaging your Psycore when played, self-inflicting damage…)
Ex : Robot, Steam Warlord

[i]Dual Core[/i]
A mutant with Dual Core can both attack and use its Action Ability during the same turn. 
Ex : Android

[i]Execution (new version)[/i]
Execution abilities now trigger whenever the mutant destroys another mutant.

[i]Reaper[/i]
Reaper abilities trigger whenever another mutant dies (usually any mutant, but there can be exceptions).
Replaces some previous Execution abilities.
Ex : Cerberus, The Forgotten One

[i]Ossuary[/i]
Ossuary abilities become active while you have at least 10 cards in your discard. 
Ex : Bushi, The Collector

[b]The Equip former keyword disappears, to be replaced by 2 new keywords.[/b]

[i]Equipped[/i]
Equipped abilities are active while the mutant has at least one Orb equipped. 
Replaces some Equip abilities. 
Ex : Barbarian

[i]Unsheathe[/i]
Unsheathe abilities trigger whenever you attach an Orb to the mutant. 
Replaces some Equip abilities. 
Ex : Master Shinzo, El Gringo (new version)

[i]Adapt (new version)[/i]
The former Adapt format changes to facilitate integration of mutants with Adapt abilities in multiple archetypes. 

The new keyword : [i]Adapt[/i] - Mutants with Adapt abilities can gain EVO when specific conditions are met.

[b]Former abilities with the Invasion keywords are modified :[/b]

[i]Invasion (new version)[/i]
Invasion abilities now trigger whenever the mutant damages a building. 
Ex : Shell Shock, Marship Mallow

[i]Demolition[/i]
Demolition abilities trigger whenever the mutant destroys a building.
Replaces some Invasion abilities
Ex : Planet Cleaner (new version)

[i]Cityscape[/i]
Cityscape abilities are linked to the presence of non-Psycore buildings on the board. 
Replaces some Invasion abilities
Ex : Alien, Behemoth (new version)

[i]Aura[/i]
Aura abilities grant bonuses or abilities to multiple mutants. 
Numerous mutants with Squad now have their Passive abilities become Auras.  

[i]Status Condition[/i]
The bold gameplay term is added to encompass Burning, Stasis, ATK/HP decreases, and numerous other effects in the future. 

[i]Cleanse[/i]

The gameplay term bold is added, and means “Remove all status conditions”.
